Rule: A requisition cannot be opened without an approved position or an approved exception.
Pay range on a job ad and offer must sit inside the approved band for grade and country.
An application is accepted only after the required privacy notice is shown and consent is recorded for the country.
No candidate is rejected or advanced on an AI score alone; a named person records the decision and reason.
Every AI-assisted step records model, version, inputs used and the human decision.
A candidate may ask for a human review of any automated step; the request is answered within [10] working days.
Assessments must be job-related and validated for the role family; unvalidated tests need written approval.
Assessment and interview accommodations are offered to every candidate and logged.
Interview recordings and transcripts are kept [6] months unless a longer period is required by law, then deleted.
Background checks start only after an accepted offer and signed consent, unless a role-specific law requires earlier.
The hiring system stores check outcome and date, never raw criminal-record detail.
Adverse decisions based on a check follow the local pre-adverse and adverse notice steps.
Identity and right-to-work must be verified before the start date; no access is provisioned before.
Safety-critical roles need a fit-for-role flag and safety induction booking before start.
Sanctions and conflict-of-interest screening applies to all senior and procurement-facing roles.
An offer is released only after all approval levels are complete and pay band is validated.
Signed offers are archived with the audit certificate and linked to the candidate record.
The employee record is created only when mandatory checks are cleared or an exception is approved by the named authority.
Unsuccessful candidate data is anonymised after [12] months by default; shorter or longer by country table.
Candidate data is processed only in approved regions; transfers need a recorded legal basis.
Each partner has scoped credentials; credentials rotate at least every [90] days.
Webhook calls are verified by signature and are idempotent; failed calls retry then go to a dead-letter queue.
Internal candidates are shown open roles at the same time as, or before, external posting where policy requires.
Job ads are checked for inclusive language before publication.
A partner cannot go live until contract tests, security review and a data-return clause are complete.
